criteria.requirement: Implement werkzeug.strict_json.read_json(request,*,max_bytes=1048576). Require actual JSON mimetype including application/*+json and UTF8 charset, enforce positive byte budget against declared and actual stream size using at most max_bytes+1 read. Respect Werkzeug WSGI stream termination rules. Decode UTF8, reject nested duplicate keys after escape decoding, nonfinite constants and float overflow; invalid syntax/encoding/empty input becomes BadRequest, unsupported media 415 and budget overflow 413. Return any valid JSON value including false/null. This consumes the stream; do not modify legacy get_json cache, globals, body limits or close caller-owned input.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
